slot_scores.name: truck_capacity_limit
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked about truck capacity or the maximum number of containers per truck, and did not explicitly mark it as an assumption needing confirmation.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Truck capacity is irrelevant or not modeled; the final model omits any truck capacity constraint.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about or confirmed the truck capacity limit, yet the READY_TO_MODEL model contains no truck capacity constraint.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The only unresolved hidden slot is P2 truck capacity, which does not affect the core cost-minimization problem or optimal objective value. The agent resolved the relevant P0/P1 modeling facts before stopping.

summary: The agent asked clear, relevant questions about supply/demand balance, cost structure, routing, and integrality, then stopped appropriately. It missed the low-impact P2 truck capacity detail and silently omitted it from the model.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
